errors.evidence: The x-axis categories in the figure are България, Чехия, Естония, Финландия, Франция, Хърватия, Унгария, Литва, Словения, Словакия; the machine description repeats Словения and omits Словакия.

errors.text_span: За Финландия, стълбата за мъже е с височина 37.64, а за жени – 34.9.
errors.evidence: The figure shows Finland values of approximately 37.64 for men and 34.9 for women, but these are swapped in the description of which series corresponds to which value compared to the plotted blue/red bars.
The description does not mention the chart purpose that it shows average weekly total working hours excluding overtime, which is stated in the reference and visible in the figure context.
The description gives the y-axis title and range, but does not state that the x-axis countries are ordered alphabetically, which is an important structural feature noted in the reference.
